finding_key: packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts::array / non-object table cells are silently skipped by the new guard and stored, crashing the renderer — inconsistent with the array rejection the same diff adds for a text element's `data`
evidence: Verified in docs-content.controller.ts (assertValidElementData table branch): `if (!cell || typeof cell !== 'object' || Array.isArray(cell)) continue;` silently accepts null/array cells, which writeSlidesRoot then persists verbatim. In packages/slides/src/view/canvas/table-renderer.ts, an array cell passes the `!cell`/`isCovered` guards (gridSpan/rowSpan undefined → not covered) and crashes at paddingOf's `cell.style.padding`; a null cell crashes packages/slides/src/export/pdf.ts's `bodies.push(cell.body)`. This contradicts the same diff's explicit rejection of an array text-element `data` and its stated guarantee that no deck is persisted in a viewer-crashing shape, so the inconsistency the claim describes is real.
